title: A Survey of Direct Preference Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and categorizing mitigation strategies in DPO literature, specifically evaluating methods such as length regularization, length normalization, and length sampling to counteract the model's tendency to favor excessively long responses.

Reviewing algorithmic approaches (e.g., MinMax-DPO, GRPO) that address annotator heterogeneity by balancing preference optimization across different subgroups to prevent models from skewing toward majority viewpoints and neglecting underrepresented groups.
